[WATCH] Maleka Khan’s tale of 1971 (Part-4)
2016-12-25T17:27:54+06:00 | Khalid Hussain Ayon
https://www.thedailystar.net/video-stories/watch-maleka-khans-tale-1971-part-4-1335376

Maleka Khan, former director of Bangladesh Central Women's Rehabilitation Centre and former organising secretary of Bangladesh Girl Guides Association, shares her story of losing her younger brother in the Liberation War in 1971 .

WATCH MORE: Part 1 , Part 2 , and Part 3

Her brother Lieutenant Atiqur Rahman was an engineering core officer of Pakistan Army posted in the Comilla Cantonment. Atiqur was killed by the Pakistan Army along with other Bengali officers and soldiers soon after the war broke out.

To know more of her preceding stories visit our YouTube channel, Star Live .
